title: Repeating Sequence Interpolated
text: Output discrete-time sequence and repeat, interpolating between data points, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets the output data type; {Vector of output values}, {Vector of time values}, {Lookup Method} sets the lookup method for output Interpolation-Use End, {Sample time} sets the time interval between samples, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking and {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} prevents fixed-point tools from overriding data. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Lookup Method
params.values: Lookup method for output Interpolation-Use End Values (default) | Use Input Nearest | Use Input Below | Use Input Above

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type double (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | single | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Prevent fixed-point tools from overriding data types off (default) | on
